pages.text: Learn and equip Backspines. Kills accumulate orbiting spines. Lock a target to concentrate a volley; otherwise nearby targets can share it. Invest separately in capacity for a larger stock and duration to retain the stock longer.

Learn Critical Mass and the desired devastator. Consume at full health to build the blue reserve. Fully charge attack + use for Graveyard Spikes, use + grab for Tendril Barrage, or attack + grab for Critical Pain. A short reserve can cost health.
